name: jyri363 Bonus Pricing
author: jyri363

sections.description:
View the live demo shop — change a product’s quantity to try live unit prices and active pricing tiers. The demo also includes Pro minimum quantities and quantity steps.

jyri363 Bonus Pricing provides the free core pricing tools needed by many WooCommerce stores. For advanced pricing workflows, jyri363 Bonus Pricing Pro is available separately and extends the Free edition while Free continues to work independently.

Core Free features:

  • product-level quantity pricing
  • loyalty pricing based on the customer spending history
  • optional cart subtotal discount tiers
  • live unit-price feedback on the product page
  • support for simple products and variable products with variation-level quantity rules
  • WPML-ready custom strings for frontend labels

The Free plugin remains a stable standalone foundation. It does not lock existing features behind upgrade prompts, and Pro is implemented as a separate add-on plugin.

Typical use cases:

  • 100–299 pcs = one unit price, 300+ pcs = another unit price
  • a repeat customer gets an automatic loyalty discount
  • an extra discount is shown and applied when the cart subtotal reaches a target amount
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP from Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open a product in WooCommerce and use the new Pricing logic tab inside Product data.
  5. Configure loyalty settings under WooCommerce → Bonus Prices.
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes. Parent-level quantity rules can act as fallback rules, and each variation can also use its own quantity pricing rules.

What PHP version is required?

The Free plugin declares a minimum of PHP 7.4 for backward compatibility with older WordPress and WooCommerce installations. The source has been reviewed for PHP 7.4-compatible syntax and APIs, but this release has not been run under every PHP version; PHP 7.4 runtime compatibility should be verified in the target environment. PHP 7.4, 8.0, and 8.1 are no longer maintained by the PHP project and are not recommended for production. Use a supported PHP release (preferably PHP 8.3 or newer) and keep WordPress and WooCommerce up to date. WooCommerce and WordPress may require a higher PHP version than this plugin.

Does it work with ThemeComplete Extra Product Options (EPO)?

The product-page live-pricing script includes EPO-aware handling, including EPO price-update events and totals containers. EPO is a separately distributed plugin, so stores using advanced option pricing should verify their exact EPO configuration after major WooCommerce or EPO updates.

Does the plugin remove its data on uninstall?

Yes. The plugin includes an uninstall.php file that removes its options, post meta, order-item meta, and transient cache entries when the plugin is deleted from WordPress.

Is WPML required?

No. WPML integration is optional. The plugin works without WPML.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. jyri363 Bonus Pricing Pro is available separately. The Free plugin works independently and does not require Pro.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • Lowered the declared PHP minimum to 7.4 for legacy compatibility (WordPress.org plugin metadata and install/update checks).
  • Reviewed PHP source for PHP 7.4-compatible syntax and built-in API usage. PHP 7.4 runtime has not been verified; compatibility remains subject to the installed WordPress and WooCommerce versions.
  • Kept the Free feature set unchanged, including quantity rules, loyalty/cart discounts, variation pricing, and optional Pro add-on integration.
  • Clarified in the documentation that legacy PHP versions are end-of-life and should not be used on production stores.

1.0.5

  • Corrected the minimum PHP requirement from 8.3 to 8.2 so compatible PHP 8.2 stores are not blocked from updating.
  • Reviewed the plugin code for PHP 8.2 compatibility; no PHP 8.3-only syntax or APIs are required.
  • Kept the PHP 8.3.36 compatibility note while separating it from the minimum PHP requirement.
  • No pricing features were removed or restricted in this maintenance release.

1.0.4

  • Hardened Free-to-Pro/add-on extension filters by re-normalizing filtered pricing modes, stack policies, quantity rules, labels, and settings before use.
  • Hardened malformed quantity, context, base-price, and admin checkbox inputs for safer PHP 8.x behaviour.
  • Batched loyalty order-history queries to avoid loading an unlimited order ID list into memory on large stores.
  • Reviewed compatibility for PHP 8.3.36 and kept the minimum PHP requirement at 8.3.
  • Updated WooCommerce compatibility metadata to 11.2 after reviewing the 11.2 backward-compatible developer changes relevant to this plugin.

1.0.3

  • Put the live demo link first in the description and add a demo action link to the installed plugins list.
  • Reject non-finite extension-filtered prices and malformed pricing metadata.
  • Validate variation products and parent edit permissions before saving rules through WooCommerce product CRUD.

1.0.2

  • Resolve the queried product when live pricing assets load before the theme initializes the global product.
  • Update the active quantity tier and current unit price even without a summary price element.
  • Handle quantity inputs replaced dynamically by themes and extensions.
  • Align initial live pricing with the Pro minimum quantity filter.

1.0.1

  • Added the donation link and raised the minimum PHP version to 8.3.

0.6

  • Further security hardening for malformed admin inputs, saved pricing rules, and extension-filtered settings.
  • Rejects non-finite or otherwise unsafe numeric pricing values before calculations.
  • Keeps the WordPress 7.1, WooCommerce 11.0, HPOS, EPO-aware frontend handling, and separate Pro-edition link introduced in the audited Free branch.
  • Revalidated PHP 8.x syntax and runtime safety without changing the existing Free feature set.

0.5.1

  • Security hardening: process only the expected settings fields instead of the complete POST payload.
  • Added strict scalar/type validation for admin inputs, saved pricing rules, and filtered settings to avoid malformed-value warnings or unsafe runtime values.
  • Reject non-finite numeric values and cap discount percentages safely before pricing calculations.
  • Added stricter validation for percentage values and extension-filtered pricing results.
  • Hardened frontend HTML construction for translated labels, units, hints, and currency symbols.
  • Replaced Number.isFinite usage to preserve compatibility with older JavaScript environments supported by the Free branch.
  • Updated compatibility metadata for WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.0.
  • Reviewed HPOS usage and current WooCommerce 11.0 product-editor changes; the plugin uses supported classic product APIs and WooCommerce order APIs.
  • Reviewed the existing ThemeComplete EPO integration against the current EPO 7.6.1 release notes and retained its EPO-aware frontend update handling.
  • Moved the separate Pro edition link into the opening description while keeping Free fully functional on its own.

0.5.0

  • Established the current feature set as the standalone Free edition.
  • Added the official WooCommerce plugin dependency header.
  • Declared compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Added extension hooks for product settings, effective variation settings, global settings, final price calculations, and completed plugin initialization.
  • Kept existing quantity pricing, live pricing, loyalty discounts, cart discount tiers, variable-product support, and WPML-ready strings available in Free.
  • Updated package and translation project versions to 0.5.0 and corrected the POT header metadata.
  • Added a clear link to the separately available jyri363 Bonus Pricing Pro plugin.

0.4.27

  • Renamed the cart discount shortcode to jyri363bp_cart_discount_note.
